sections.heading: Book & Journal Gift Box FAQ
sections.text: Questions Book & Journal Gift Box FAQ How do you size a box to my book? From the trim size and thickness of the finished book, or a printed copy. We leave a small clearance so the book slides in without rubbing, and add a ribbon lift so it is easy to take out. Can the box hold the book plus other items? Yes. A tray with several cavities holds the book next to items such as a pen, bookmark, candle or card; we check the layout on a 3D mock-up first. Do you print the book? No. We make the gift box and tray; the book or journal comes from your printer. What is the minimum order? 100 pcs per custom size. A physical sample takes 3–5 business days and bulk production 12–15 days after sample approval.

A book gift box turns a hardcover, collector's edition or journal into a gift: a rigid box sized to the book, a fitted tray or ribbon lift to take it out, and room for a bookmark, pen, card or small item. Publishers, authors and lifestyle brands order them for special editions, launch kits and holiday sets.
